title: Any local business (base pack; every local pack extends it)
basis: Recalled general knowledge of US local-citation and community sources, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). Apple Business Connect and Bing Places are named as the vendors' own listing programmes.

angles: Join the chamber of commerce of the city served most and complete the member directory page.
Sponsor one real local cause (youth team, school event, food bank) and ask to be named on the sponsor page with a link.
Give the local paper or city news site one useful local fact a month (a number, a tip, a how-to), not a press release.
Ask real partners (supplier, lender, neighbour business) for a resources or partners page entry, and link back where it helps a customer.
Host or speak at a free local workshop; get the event listed on the chamber, library and community calendars.
Keep name, address and phone identical everywhere; fix the mismatches the local-nap check lists before creating new listings.
avoid: Buying links, or links on a 'sponsored post' without rel="sponsored" (Google link spam).
Bulk submission to hundreds of directories, bookmark sites or 'SEO directories'.
Fake reviews, paid reviews and review gating (asking only happy customers); also against the platforms' rules and, in the US, the FTC rule on fake reviews.
A network of thin sites you own that link to each other (private blog network).
Changing the business name to add keywords on listings: it breaks consistency and breaks the platforms' rules.
